patch_description: The current program is severely over-regularized, causing predictions to collapse toward the mean (slope_ratio=20.7%, pred_std_ratio=3.5%). I'm reducing regularization parameters and increasing model capacity to allow learning transferable patterns. Additionally, I'm extending the multi-scale z-score normalization approach from the best prior program (which achieved 96% generalization) by adding ret_z features at windows [10, 20, 40, 60] and creating explicit regime shift indicators (ret_z_20 - ret_z_60, ret_z_40 - ret_z_60) that signal when recent behavior diverges from longer-term patterns. These regime shift indicators are key for handling the train→test→val regime transitions. I'm removing the less predictive time-of-day features (hour_sin, hour_cos, dow_sin, dow_cos) to stay under 80 features.
